note: Primary operator disclosures to acquire for the cases anchor.json marks production_adjudicable. A 'document' entry without sha256 is a discovery target: `discover` archives its bytes in Actions and reports the hash, a reviewer reads the document and pins the hash here, and only then may figures be entered in data/manual/natural-graphite-company-disclosures.csv. An 'index' entry is not fetched at all; it is a page for a human to browse for the real per-report document URL, because a listing page changes and is never itself evidence. Every URL below was returned by a live web search on 2026-09-14, not guessed; a 404 previously reached this manifest because discover() fetched an index entry without checking its kind, which is now fixed.
